title: Parameter puzzle
goal: It is too slow to reach the ring in time. Find out why and fix it.

steps.text: Find what makes it slow, and set it right in Parameters.
steps.hint: Its speed between places is WPNAV_SPEED, in centimetres a second. Search Parameters for it.

steps.text: Now use Go to on the ring.
steps.hint: Press Go to in the Cockpit tab, then click the ring on the map.

passed: Passed. At the ring in {elapsed} s.
